name: rclone
author: rclone.org
short_desc: Sync and back up files to Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, S3, WebDAV and 40+ other clouds — and expose any remote over WebDAV.
description: rclone synchronises and backs up files between your machines and 40+ cloud providers: Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, pCloud, Proton Drive, Backblaze B2, Amazon S3 and any S3-compatible storage (MinIO, Cloudflare R2, Wasabi, Scaleway, OVHcloud…), plus WebDAV, FTP, SFTP, SMB and WebDAV-compatible servers such as Nextcloud. It is the missing piece for two things: a personal cloud drive mounted on the server, and encrypted profile backups for Firefox and Zen Browser pushed to a remote. This packaging also exposes a remote over WebDAV with `rclone serve webdav`, so other apps can reach your cloud as a normal WebDAV mount.

form_fields.label: rclone config file path (inside the container)
form_fields.hint: The rclone configuration file, mounted from the app data directory. Create it with 'rclone config' in the app's container console. Keep it on a volume — it holds the OAuth tokens.

form_fields.label: Remote to serve over WebDAV (optional)
form_fields.hint: Name of an rclone remote, e.g. 'gdrive'. When set, the app exposes it over WebDAV on the port below, so other apps (or a phone) can mount https://<your-domain>/ as a WebDAV drive. Leave empty to disable.

form_fields.label: WebDAV server port
form_fields.hint: Internal port for 'rclone serve webdav'. Runtipi maps it to the app's host port.

form_fields.label: WebDAV user (optional)
form_fields.hint: Leave empty for an open server — only do that on a trusted LAN.

form_fields.label: WebDAV password (optional)
form_fields.hint: Password for the WebDAV user above.

form_fields.label: Directory inside the remote to expose over WebDAV
form_fields.hint: Leave empty to expose the whole remote.
